## The agent's own screen {.i-asterisk}

Every session Emaki runs has a terminal behind it: Claude Code's hidden
one, or Codex's joined to its driver. This panel draws it whole, at the
chat's right, so you can watch the agent work as you would in the
CLI, and type into it when you want to. It is the same terminal the
window reads and types into, so nothing is doubled.

Open it with nothing running and it starts the agent (Claude Code); where
one cannot start, a turn running in a terminal of your own, or an
archived session, it says why. Whatever the agent asks that the window
has no card for can be answered here. It shares the right side with the
[shell terminal](shell.qmd): one shows at a time.
